title: [Interview] Europe’s next budget risks ‘making the strong stronger’ by diverting funds from poorer areas, EU regions chief warns
lede: As 2026 draws to a close, EU institutions and capitals are finalising the bloc's 2028 to 2034 budget, with catch-up funding for poor regions likely to face deep cuts, even is its top advocate in Brussels is fighting back.
